mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal provides moderate protein and fats from the scrambled eggs and sausage patty. It is best to avoid or strictly limit sugary or high-calorie condiments like ketchup, opting for fresh vegetables or whole grain toast instead to manage blood sugar levels effectively.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Breakfast Plate with Sausage and Eggs
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A breakfast plate containing scrambled eggs, a sausage patty, and a serving of ketchup. Served with black coffee.
